objective: Create the safe PC cleanup audit package. This is design and inventory tooling only: no deletion, no local execution, no paid services. Define a structured audit schema, a discovery procedure, a read-only PowerShell inventory script that can later be run manually on Windows, and an Astra review packet. Update project memory/provenance. The audit script must never delete, uninstall, modify registry, stop services, or alter files.
constraints: No AI video inference on local PC
No cleanup deletion or uninstall actions
PowerShell script must be read-only and output an inventory report only
acceptance_criteria: External AgentOwnedCandidateRoots are actually enumerated and audited.
ActiveProjectRoot is protected and is not the default cleanup search scope.
No candidate roots supplied means no external filesystem scan beyond reading the local provenance registry.
Path containment is boundary-safe, not naive prefix matching.
Overlapping candidate roots do not produce duplicate item records.
Files in candidate roots are review-only, never automatically removable; files inside active project are KEEP_ACTIVE.
Script has no destructive or system-modifying operations and emits JSON to stdout only.
Schema and review packet match the script behavior and remain PENDING_ASTRA_REVIEW.
retry_reason: Final pre-Astra functional correction: the latest script only enumerates TargetDirectory, so AgentOwnedCandidateRoots outside the active project are never scanned. As written, almost every default-scanned file becomes KEEP_ACTIVE and the audit cannot discover previous agent-owned installations elsewhere on the PC.
orchestrator_corrections: Restore separate ActiveProjectRoot and AgentOwnedCandidateRoots parameters. ActiveProjectRoot defaults to current directory. AgentOwnedCandidateRoots defaults empty.
Enumerate each explicitly supplied AgentOwnedCandidateRoot independently even when it is outside ActiveProjectRoot. These roots are the actual cleanup-audit search scope.

Do not recursively inventory the entire ActiveProjectRoot just to create cleanup candidates. ActiveProjectRoot exists primarily as a protected exclusion boundary and as the location of PROVENANCE_REGISTRY.jsonl.

For every file found under an AgentOwnedCandidateRoot: if it is inside ActiveProjectRoot, status KEEP_ACTIVE and evidence_source ACTIVE_PROJECT; otherwise if exact normalized provenance match, CANDIDATE_REVIEW_ONLY and evidence_source EXACT_PROVENANCE_MATCH; otherwise CANDIDATE_REVIEW_ONLY and evidence_source EXPLICIT_AGENT_OWNED_ROOT.
Use a path-boundary-safe containment test based on GetRelativePath or equivalent. Do not use naive string StartsWith that can confuse C:\Project with C:\Project2.
Deduplicate files when candidate roots overlap.
AgentOwnedCandidateRoots must remain empty by default, so the default invocation scans no external candidate paths and cannot wander across home/system drives.
Unknown paths outside explicitly supplied candidate roots must not be scanned or classified. No whole-drive/home/system scan.
Keep the script strictly non-destructive and stdout-only. Do not add OutputPath/file-writing behavior in this candidate.
Keep required size_bytes, evidence_source, provenance_match, status, reason, exact path provenance, Google Drive state, zero spend, and PENDING_ASTRA_REVIEW.
Use exact model gemini-3.1-flash-lite in provenance metadata and filenames.
